# vastdata_compute_cluster_tenants (Data Source)

Tenants associated with a compute cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vastdata_compute_cluster_tenants" "tf_test_cluster_tenants" {
  compute_cluster_name = "tf-test-cluster"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `compute_cluster_id` (Number) Compute cluster ID. Provide this or compute_cluster_name.
- `compute_cluster_name` (String) Compute cluster name. Used to look up the cluster ID when compute_cluster_id is not set.

### Read-Only

- `cluster_tenants` (Attributes List) Tenants associated with the compute cluster. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cluster_tenants))

<a id="nestedatt--cluster_tenants"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cluster_tenants`

Read-Only:

- `compute_cluster` (Number) Compute Cluster ID.
- `de_compute_guid` (String) Data Engine compute GUID.
- `de_mtls_cert_guid` (String) Data Engine mTLS certificate GUID.
- `status` (String) Status of the tenant association.
- `tenant_id` (Number) Tenant ID.
